decision.reason: [ev-0bb0d885678d] says only that "service/servicemon definitions" now use port names instead of numbers. It does not say which Service or ServiceMonitor objects changed (for example, which component's metrics or webhook service), which field changed (such as a Service targetPort or a ServiceMonitor endpoint port), or what the new port names are. The rest of the Feature section ([ev-30d2c387f95f] through [ev-330bb03a882f]) says nothing more about this change, and no upgrade-guide section is shown. Without PR #7727 or the rendered chart diff, an engineer cannot write the subject without guessing at a resource identity or field path.
